newsitem.title: GERMANY: Steel takes share from aluminium can use in Europe.
newsitem.headline: Steel takes share from aluminium can use in Europe.

text.p: Aluminium's share in the 32-billion a year European beverage can market this year would drop amid competition from tinplated steel, Michael Herdman of Nacanco Services (Europe) Ltd said.
Speaking at Metal Bulletin's 11th aluminium conference, he said aluminium's share in 1995 had risen to 54 percent versus steel's 46 percent after a 50-50 relationship in the early nineties.
But this year aluminium could shed five percentage points as steelmakers had used aluminium's recent high price phase to offer the drinks industry competitive rates.
But Herdman, who also cited British and Italian can line conversions to steel plus new steel capacity, said aluminium may move back above 50 percent next year.
Nacano is a part of French aluminium and packaging giant Pechiney.
